structure.count_authority_reason: This is CHAPTER 1 ONLY of a 3-chapter print edition (K.K. Pathak, 1999). Chapters 2-3 (~85% of the book) carry NO printed verse numbers at all in either of the two independent OCR passes used here (`-l san`, `-l hin`) -- confirmed absent in the source, not lost in extraction -- and are therefore not digitisable from this source; they remain out of scope until a differently-numbered witness is found. Within chapter 1, numbering is resolved positionally: the sequence runs a clean, duplicate-free 1..84 with ZERO gaps once each raw marker reading is checked against the next expected integer, allowing for the `san` pass's own leading-'1' glue bug (confirmed on ~40% of its markers) and cross-checked against the independent `hin` pass wherever legible. Verse 64 is a single unpaired pāda in BOTH OCR passes -- the edition's own Hindi translation glosses 63-64 together -- and is recorded as a unit-pairing note (RUN_TOGETHER), not a gap: its content is present and entire.
structure.known_gaps_reason: Empty: every one of chapter 1's 84 verse numbers is present, confirmed by positional resolution against the source's own (glue-corrected) markers. shlokas.text: क्ररकषत्रे यदा जनम अस्तको लग्ननायकः| अकं जीवे तथा पातः सोऽष्टवर्षन जीवति
shlokas.english_draft: If birth occurs in a sign of Mars with the lord of the Ascendant set, and Jupiter is associated with the Sun or Rahu/Ketu, the native lives for eight years.

shlokas.text: षष्ठाष्टमे च मूर्तो च बुधभौमो यदा स्थितौ तस्करं घोरकर्माणा करपादं विनश्यति
shlokas.english_draft: If Mercury and Mars are situated in the 6th, 8th, or 1st house (Lagna), the native becomes a thief of cruel deeds and suffers destruction of hands and feet.

shlokas.text: षष्ठाष्टमे च मूर्तो च जन्मकाले यदा बुधः| चतुर्वर्षं भवेत्मृत्युरमृते यदि सिंचति
shlokas.english_draft: If Mercury is situated in the 6th, 8th, or 1st house at the time of birth, death occurs within four years, unless sprinkled with nectar (benefic aspect).

shlokas.text: भौमकषेत्रे यदि जीवः जीवक्षेत्रे च मंगलः। द्वादशाब्दे भवेन्मृत्यु रक्षते यदि शंकरः
shlokas.english_draft: If Jupiter is in the sign of Mars and Mars is in the sign of Jupiter, death occurs in the twelfth year, unless protected by Lord Shankara.

shlokas.text: भोमक्ेत्रे यदा जीवः षष्ठाष्टम दितीयकः| षष्ठे वर्षे भवेन्मत्युं जातकस्य न संशयः
shlokas.english_draft: If Jupiter is in the sign of Mars situated in the 6th, 8th, or 2nd house, death of the native occurs in the sixth year, without doubt.

shlokas.text: जन्ममूरतो यदा राहुरष्टषष्ठे च चन्द्रमाः विंशद्रात्रौ भवेन्मृत्युजतिकस्य न संशयः
shlokas.english_draft: If Rahu is in the Ascendant and the Moon is in the 8th or 6th house, death of the child occurs within twenty nights, without doubt.

shlokas.text: चतुर्थपि यदा राहु केन्द्रे भवति चन्द्रमाः। विंशद्रात्रौ भवेन्मृत्युर्जातिकस्य न संशयः
shlokas.english_draft: If Rahu is in the 4th house and the Moon is in a Kendra, death occurs within twenty nights, without doubt.

shlokas.text: सप्तभस्थो यदा राहूर्जन्मलग्ने यदा शशी | दशवर्ष भवेन्यमृत्युरमृते यदि सिंचति
shlokas.english_draft: If Rahu is in the 7th house and the Moon is in the birth Lagna, death occurs in the tenth year, unless sprinkled with nectar (benefic influence).

shlokas.text: दादशे च यदा चन्द्रो षष्ठे पापग्रहो भवेत्‌ अल्पायुर्जायते बालोदररोगी न संशयः
shlokas.english_draft: If the Moon is in the 12th house and a malefic planet is in the 6th house, the child becomes short-lived and suffers from abdominal diseases, without doubt.

shlokas.text: नवमे दशमे राहुर्जन्ममकाले यदा र्थितः। षोडशाब्दे भवेन्मृत्यर्यदि शक्रोऽपि रक्षति
shlokas.english_draft: If Rahu is positioned in the 9th or 10th house at birth, death occurs in the sixteenth year, even if Indra (Shakra) tries to protect him.

shlokas.text: रनिक्षेत्रे यदा भानुः भानुक्षेवे यदि शनिः। विंशे वर्ष भवेन्मृत्युरुत्न्नो यदि बालकः
shlokas.english_draft: If the Sun is in the house of Saturn and Saturn is in the house of the Sun, the born child faces death in the twentieth year.

shlokas.text: जन्मलग्ने यदाराहूुः षष्ठे वायदि चंद्रमाः। गुदारोगी च मंदाग्निः अंगहीनो हि जायते
shlokas.english_draft: If Rahu is in the birth Lagna or the Moon is in the 6th house, the person suffers from rectal diseases, sluggish digestion, and becomes defective in limbs.

shlokas.text: षष्टाष्टमे जन्मकाले स्थितौ च शनिभास्करौ | राजरोगे भवेन्मृत्युर्जातकस्य न संशय
shlokas.english_draft: If Saturn and the Sun are located in the 6th or 8th house at birth, death of the native occurs due to Rajaroga (tuberculosis/wasting disease), without doubt.

shlokas.text: जन्मकाले तनुस्थाने भवेद्ेवोऽपि भास्करः। रथानहीनो भवेद्बालो शोकसंतापकारकः
shlokas.english_draft: If the divine Sun is in the 1st house (Tanu bhava) at birth, the child becomes displaced/homeless and suffers sorrow and distress.

shlokas.text: दशमस्थोयद भौम उच्चे शत्रुगृहे रिथितः। सूतकेपि तदामृत्युर्भवेन्मातुर्न संशयः
shlokas.english_draft: If Mars in the 10th house is exalted or situated in an enemy's sign, death of the mother occurs during childbirth/confinement, without doubt.

shlokas.text: लग्नेऽष्टमे यदा राहुश्चन्द्र वा यदि पश्यति । सूतकेपि तदा मृत्युः शक्रोऽपि यदि रक्षति
shlokas.english_draft: If Rahu is in the 1st or 8th house and aspects the Moon, death occurs during infant confinement, even if protected by Lord Indra.

shlokas.text: केन्द्रे शुक्रगुरौ यस्य द्वादशे यदि भास्करः। लग्ने बुधश्च संप्राप्तः शतंजीवति बालकः
shlokas.english_draft: If Venus and Jupiter are in Kendra houses, the Sun in the 12th house, and Mercury in the Lagna, the child lives for a hundred years.

shlokas.text: गुरु्धनुषिमीने च तथा कर्कटकेऽपि चं लग्नात्रिकोणकेन्द्रे वा तदारिष्टं न जायते
shlokas.english_draft: If Jupiter is in Sagittarius, Pisces, or Cancer, situated in a Kendra or Trikona from Lagna, no evil (arishta) affects the native.

shlokas.text: बुधभार्गवजीवनामेकोऽपि यदि केन्द्रगः| स्वरथानबलसंयुक्तस्तदारिष्टं न जायते
shlokas.english_draft: If even one among Mercury, Venus, or Jupiter occupies a Kendra endowed with own-sign strength, no evil (arishta) occurs.

shlokas.text: शनेश्चरस्तुला कुंभो मकरे च यदा भवेत्‌| आदये षष्ठतृतीये च तदारिष्टं न जायते
shlokas.english_draft: If Saturn is in Libra, Aquarius, or Capricorn, situated in the 1st, 6th, or 3rd house, no evil (arishta) affects the child.

shlokas.text: यदा भानुर्भवेत्‌ सिंहे मेषे च मित्रवीक्षितः| यदि षष्ठोऽपि लाभस्थस्तदारिष्टं न जायते
shlokas.english_draft: If the Sun is in Leo or Aries aspected by friendly planets, or if located in the 6th or 11th house, no evil (arishta) occurs.

shlokas.text: मेषे वृषे कुलीरे वा रार्हुलग्नमुपासितः। यदा सौम्यग्रहेरदष्टे तदारिष्टं न जायते
shlokas.english_draft: If Rahu occupies the Lagna in Aries, Taurus, or Cancer and is aspected by benefic planets, no evil (arishta) takes effect.

shlokas.text: लग्ने सौरिस्तथा चनद्रस्त्रिकोणे जीवभास्करौ | कर्मस्थाने यदा भेमोराजयोगौ विधीयते
shlokas.english_draft: If Saturn and Moon are in Lagna, Jupiter and Sun in Trikona, and Mars in the 10th house, a powerful Raja Yoga is formed.

shlokas.text: नवमे च यदा सूर्यः स्वगृहस्थो यदा भवेत्‌ तस्य नो जीवति भ्राता एकोऽपि च नृपैः सम
shlokas.english_draft: If the Sun is in the 9th house in its own sign (Leo), the native's brother does not survive, but the native becomes equal to a king.

shlokas.text: कर्मस्थाने निजक्षत्री यदि राहुर्भवेदिह | भोमशुक्रवुधैर्युक्तः क्षणे वृद्धिः क्षणे क्षयः
shlokas.english_draft: If Rahu is in its own sign in the 10th house combined with Mars, Venus, and Mercury, the native experiences instant growth and instant loss.

shlokas.text: धनस्थाने यदा क्रूरः सहजे च तमस्सथा | पंचमे च भवेज्जीवो नीचजातिस्तदा भवेत्‌
shlokas.english_draft: If a malefic is in the 2nd house, Rahu in the 3rd house, and Jupiter in the 5th house, the native acts like a low-caste or degraded person.

shlokas.text: नवपंचचतुर्थषु स्थाने सूर्यादयो ग्रहाः || आदौ जाता विनश्यन्ति पश्चाज्जातश्च जीवति
shlokas.english_draft: If the Sun and other planets occupy the 9th, 5th, and 4th houses, earlier born siblings perish while those born later survive.

shlokas.text: धनस्थौ यदा क्रूरः भौमसौरिसमन्वितः। सहजे च यदा राहुस्तस्य भ्राता न जीवति
shlokas.english_draft: If malefics together with Mars and Saturn occupy the 2nd house and Rahu is in the 3rd house, the native's brother does not survive.

shlokas.text: धने व्यये तदा लग्ने सप्तमे भवने ग्रहः | छत्रयोगं विजानीयात्स्वकुले नायको भवेत्‌
shlokas.english_draft: If planets occupy the 2nd, 12th, 1st, and 7th houses, know this to be Chhatra Yoga; the person becomes a leader in his lineage.

shlokas.text: लग्ने शुक्रो व्यये सोम्यो धने क्रूरस्तथेव च। राजयोगे भवेदाजा दानदारिद्रयभास्करः
shlokas.english_draft: If Venus is in Lagna, Mercury in the 12th house, and a malefic in the 2nd house, the native attains Raja Yoga to become a king, radiant like the sun in charity and eradicating poverty.

shlokas.text: लग्ने क्रूरो व्यये क्रूरो धने सौम्यस्तथेव च| सप्तमे भवने क्रूरः परिवारक्षयंकरः
shlokas.english_draft: If malefics are in the Lagna, 12th, and 7th houses while a benefic is in the 2nd house, the native causes the destruction of his family.

shlokas.text: धने चंद्रे च सौरिश्च मेषे जीवो यदा भवेत्‌ दशमे राहु शुक्रौ च राजयोगो विधीयते
shlokas.english_draft: If Moon and Saturn are in the 2nd house, Jupiter in Aries, and Rahu and Venus in the 10th house, Raja Yoga is produced.

shlokas.text: धने व्ययेऽष्टमे क्रूरो जन्मकाले भवेद्यदि | तस्य त्वक्षिविनाशश्च द्वादशाष्टमवासरे
shlokas.english_draft: If malefics are present in the 2nd, 12th, and 8th houses at birth, destruction of the native's eyes occurs within 12 to 18 days.

shlokas.text: अष्टमे भवने भौमः सप्तमे राहु संभवः | भौमः सौरेण संयुक्तस्य भ्राता न जीवति
shlokas.english_draft: If Mars is in the 8th house, Rahu in the 7th house, and Mars is associated with Saturn, the native's brother does not live.

shlokas.text: तिथ्यते च दिनांते च लग्नस्यांते तथैव च रात्रावपि च यो जातः सोन्यजातो भविष्यति
shlokas.english_draft: One born at the junction of Tithi (Tithi-anta), day-end (Dinanta), Lagna-end (Lagnanta), or at night under such sandhis becomes born of another (illegitimate/adopted).

shlokas.text: स्वकषेत्रस्थो यदा भौमः कर्मस्थाने निरीक्षते । बुधः क्रूरसमाविष्टः स्वल्पकर्मफलप्रदः
shlokas.english_draft: If Mars in its own sign aspects the 10th house and Mercury is joined by a malefic, the native reaps very little fruit for his actions.

shlokas.text: सिंहे जीवस्तथा शुक्रो कन्यायां मिथुने शनिः। स्वक्षेत्रे हिबुके भौमः स पुमान्नायको भवेत्‌
shlokas.english_draft: If Jupiter and Venus are in Leo, Saturn in Gemini/Virgo, and Mars in its own sign in the 4th house (hibuka), that man becomes a great leader.

shlokas.text: कन्यायां सौरिचंद्रे च मृगे भौमे घटे तमः। सिंहे जीवस्तथा जातो दुष्टपक्षक्षयकरः
shlokas.english_draft: If Saturn and Moon are in Virgo, Mars in Capricorn, Rahu in Aquarius, and Jupiter in Leo, the person born destroys hostile factions.

shlokas.text: अस्मिन्योगे समुत्पन्नः सामान्यो नैव मानवः कुटुम्बस्य समुद्धर्ता स भवेद्राजयोगतः
shlokas.english_draft: One born under this combination is no ordinary human; through Raja Yoga, he becomes the savior and uplifter of his family.

shlokas.text: शुक्रो जीवो रविभौमो धनुर्मकर कुंभयोः। मीने च तत्सरे विंशे जातस्य क्रूर कर्मकृत्‌
shlokas.english_draft: If Venus, Jupiter, Sun, and Mars occupy Sagittarius, Capricorn, Aquarius, and Pisces respectively, in his 20th year the native performs fierce/cruel deeds.

shlokas.text: एकादशे यदा क्रूरः पंचमे शुक्रशीतगू | प्रथमे कन्या जन्म माता तस्य सकणष्टका
shlokas.english_draft: If a malefic is in the 11th house, Venus and Moon in the 5th, and birth occurs in Virgo Lagna, the native's mother suffers great hardship.

shlokas.text: सुहत्स्थाने यदा राहूर्धनस्थाने बृहस्पतिः। बुधो वा नवमे षष्ठे तस्यं ब॑धुक्षयंकरः
shlokas.english_draft: If Rahu is in the 4th house, Jupiter in the 2nd house, and Mercury in the 9th or 6th house, it brings destruction to relatives.

shlokas.text: धर्मरथाने यदा जीवों बुधः शुक्रस्तथा शशी । तस्य कार्याणि सिध्यन्ति राजमान्यो भवेन्नरः
shlokas.english_draft: If Jupiter, Mercury, Venus, and the Moon occupy the 9th house (Dharma sthana), all his undertakings succeed and he becomes honored by kings.

shlokas.text: षष्ठाष्टमे पंचमे च नवमे द्वादशे तथा| सौम्यक्रूरग्रहैर्योगि राजमान्यो सकष्टकः
shlokas.english_draft: If benefics and malefics combine in the 6th, 8th, 5th, 9th, and 12th houses, the person becomes honored by kings yet experiences troubles.

shlokas.text: पंचषष्टाष्टमगता नवमस्था यथाक्रमम्‌| भौमो राहुः शितः सूर्यः स्वपक्षपरिपालकः
shlokas.english_draft: If Mars, Rahu, Venus, and Sun are positioned respectively in the 5th, 6th, 8th, and 9th houses, the native protects and nourishes his own kinsmen.

shlokas.text: लग्ने सौरिस्तथा चन्द्रश्चाष्टमे भवनेशितः | राजमान्यो तथा कामी भोगवांश्च यथा तथा
shlokas.english_draft: If Saturn and Moon are in Lagna and the lord of Lagna is in the 8th house, the native is royal-honored, passionate, and enjoys pleasures everywhere.

shlokas.text: मकरस्थो यदा चंद्रो नीचे शत्रुगृहे र्थितः। भ्रातृवर्गतथा कष्टं यदि स्वामी न पश्यति
shlokas.english_draft: If the Moon is in Capricorn in debilitation or in an enemy's sign without aspect of its lord, hardship befalls the native's brothers.

shlokas.text: मिथुनस्थो यदा राहु सिंहस्थो भूमिनंदनः | वृश्चिके च यदा जीवो तदा जातो नृपो भवेत्‌
shlokas.english_draft: If Rahu is in Gemini, Mars in Leo, and Jupiter in Scorpio, the child born becomes a sovereign king.

shlokas.text: कुमे सौरिर्धने सूर्यो मेषे वै चंद्रमा भवेत्‌। मकरे च तथा भौमः स्व॑भुक्ते वा पितुर्धनम्‌
shlokas.english_draft: If Saturn is in Aquarius, Sun in the 2nd house, Moon in Aries, and Mars in Capricorn, the native himself enjoys paternal wealth.

shlokas.text: दशमस्थौ बुधदित्यौ षष्टे राहुधरासुतौ | राजयोगे च यो जातः स पुमान्नायको भवेत्‌
shlokas.english_draft: If Sun and Mercury are in the 10th house, and Rahu and Mars are in the 6th house, the native born in this Raja Yoga becomes a ruler.

shlokas.text: स्वगृहे दशमे सूर्यः तुलायां सूर्यजो रिपौ | बुधेन्दू मिथुने धर्मे राजयोगोऽभिजायते
shlokas.english_draft: If the Sun is in the 10th house in own sign (Leo), Saturn in Libra in the 6th house, and Mercury and Moon in Gemini in the 9th house, Raja Yoga arises.

shlokas.text: आदौ जीवः शितश्चांत्ये ग्रहामध्ये निरंतर | राजयोगं विजानीयात्‌ कुटुबबलवर्धनः
shlokas.english_draft: If Jupiter is at the beginning, Venus at the end, and other planets continuously in between, know it as Raja Yoga which increases family strength.

shlokas.text: सहजस्थ यदा जीवो मृत्युस्थाने यदा सितः। निरतरं ग्रहा मध्ये राजा भवति निश्चितम्‌
shlokas.english_draft: If Jupiter is in the 3rd house, Venus in the 8th house, and planets continuously occupy the intervening houses, the person surely becomes a king.

shlokas.text: वृषे जीवस्तथा चंद्रो मिथुने मकरे कूजः। सिंहस्थो यदि शुक्रश्च कन्यायां बुधभास्करौ
shlokas.english_draft: If Jupiter and Moon are in Taurus, Mars in Capricorn, Venus in Leo, and Mercury and Sun in Virgo...

shlokas.text: तुलायां जायते सौरी राजयोगो भवेद्यदा | योगेसिमिन्पुण्यवान्नयायौ जायते मानवः शुभः
shlokas.english_draft: ...and Saturn is in Libra, when such Raja Yoga occurs, a virtuous, just, auspicious, and noble human being is born.

shlokas.text: अष्टमे द्वादशे वर्षे यदि जीवति बालकः। तदा कूदुम्बमध्यं तु पूर्वं जातान्समुद्धरेत्‌
shlokas.english_draft: If the child survives the 8th and 12th years, he will elevate and support his family and elders born before him.

shlokas.text: क्रूरश्च तुलकेन्दरेषु तथा क्रूरो धनेऽपि च। दारिद्रययोगजातश्च स्वयंपक्षक्षयंकरः
shlokas.english_draft: If malefic planets occupy Kendras and the 2nd house, a Daridra (poverty) Yoga is formed, destroying one's own kinsmen.

shlokas.text: दशमे भवने चन्द्रौ सप्तमे भवने शितः पापैः पातालसंस्थेश्च वंशचछेदकरो नरः
shlokas.english_draft: If Moon is in the 10th house, Venus in the 7th, and malefics occupy the 4th house (patala), the native causes the termination of his lineage.

shlokas.text: मीनस्थे च यदा जीवो धने सौरिः यदा भवेत्‌। राहुश्च सहजे यस्य माता तस्य न जीवति
shlokas.english_draft: If Jupiter is in Pisces, Saturn in the 2nd house, and Rahu in the 3rd house, the native's mother does not survive.

shlokas.text: सप्तमे भवने भौमश्चाष्टमे च यदा शितः। नवमे च भवेत्सूर्यः स्वल्पायुश्च भवेन्नरः
shlokas.english_draft: If Mars is in the 7th house, Venus in the 8th house, and the Sun in the 9th house, the native becomes short-lived.

shlokas.text: तस्य भ्राता भवेदन्यान्प्रीतात्मा च समुद्धरेत्‌। जीवके च भवेल्लग्ने सर्वयोगे शुभंकरः
shlokas.english_draft: His brother will be affectionate and elevate others, and if Jupiter is in Lagna, it bestows auspiciousness across all combinations.

shlokas.text: दीर्घजीवी महाप्राज्ञो स पुमान्नायको भवेत्‌| अस्मिन्योगे भवेज्जातो स विभुर्दभवर्जित
shlokas.english_draft: Long-lived, highly wise, that man becomes a leader; born under this yoga, he becomes a lord free from affliction.

shlokas.text: दानभोगादिविख्यातः सामान्यः संभवेन्न हि| ककं सौरिर्वृषे राहुर्बहुभार्यायुतो नरः
shlokas.english_draft: Famed for charity and enjoyment, he is no ordinary person. If Saturn is in Cancer and Rahu in Taurus, the man possesses multiple wives.

shlokas.text: वीक्षिते तु सुतस्थाने सौरिर्यत्रतदेकिकः
shlokas.english_draft: If Saturn aspects the house of children (5th house), children are few or single.

shlokas.text: राहुजीवौ रिपु्षत्रे लग्ने सथानाच्चतुर्थके | उमापतिर्यदि रक्षेन्नाशं याति त्रयोदशे
shlokas.english_draft: If Rahu and Jupiter occupy an enemy sign in the 4th house from Lagna, unless Lord Shiva (Umapati) protects him, he meets destruction in his 13th year.

shlokas.text: लग्नात्स्यादष्टमे भौमस्त्रिकोणे नीचगो रविः | शीघ्रं च गुरुधर्मस्थो लक्ष्मीपात्रं भवेन्नरः
shlokas.english_draft: If Mars is in the 8th from Lagna and Sun in debilitation in a Trikona, but Jupiter is swiftly in the 9th house (Dharma), the man becomes a recipient of fortune (Lakshmi).

shlokas.text: मीनांशे शुक्रो बुधःस्वांशे लग्नंसूर्यः शशी धने। सहजे च भवेद्भमौमो राजयोगं प्रयच्छति
shlokas.english_draft: If Venus is in Pisces Navamsha, Mercury in own Navamsha, Sun in Lagna, Moon in 2nd house, and Mars in 3rd house, it bestows Raja Yoga.

shlokas.text: अस्मिन्योगे भवेज्जातो देवतागुरुपूजकः| स्वदेशे परदेशे च विख्यातो जनदुर्लभः
shlokas.english_draft: One born in this yoga worships gods and preceptors, becoming famous both in his homeland and abroad, rare among men.

shlokas.text: व्यये जीवो धने सौरी रविभौमोबुधस्तथा। विवाहसमये तस्य स जातो प्रियते पिता
shlokas.english_draft: If Jupiter is in the 12th house, Saturn in the 2nd, and Sun, Mars, and Mercury together, the native's father passes away at the time of the native's marriage.

shlokas.text: भ्रातृस्थाने यदा जीवो लाभस्थाने शशी भवेत्‌| स्वज्ञातिमध्ये विख्यातः कुटुबकुलदीपकः
shlokas.english_draft: If Jupiter is in the 3rd house (Bhratri sthana) and Moon in the 11th house (Labha sthana), he becomes famous among his kinsmen and a lamp of his family lineage.

shlokas.text: लग्ने शुक्रो धने चन्द्रः सहजस्थो यदा गुरुः| तदार्जितं पितुर्द्रव्यं यच्छुक्रो नैव पश्यति
shlokas.english_draft: If Venus is in Lagna, Moon in 2nd house, and Jupiter in 3rd house, wealth earned by the father is enjoyed, provided Venus does not aspect.

shlokas.text: सिंहे भौमस्तथा सौरिः कन्यायां य यदाशितः। मिथुने च यदा राहूर्भियते जननी शिशोः
shlokas.english_draft: If Mars and Saturn are in Leo, Venus in Virgo, and Rahu in Gemini, the infant's mother passes away.

shlokas.text: अस्मिन्योगे तु यो जातो बालभावेपि निर्धनः विधुभौमो च एकस्थौ तदा सौख्यं प्रचक्षते
shlokas.english_draft: One born under this combination, though poor in childhood, experiences happiness when Moon and Mars are together.

shlokas.text: स्वस्थाने लग्नगः क्रूरः पाताले सप्तमस्तथा | दशमे भवने क्रूरः षष्ठं जीवति बालकः
shlokas.english_draft: If malefics occupy own signs in Lagna, 4th (Patala), 7th, and 10th houses (all Kendras), the child lives for six years.

shlokas.text: अस्मिन्योगे सुतो जातो मातुर्दुःरवकरो भवेत्‌| यदि जीवो न पश्यति मातृपक्षक्षयंकरः
shlokas.english_draft: A son born in this yoga causes sorrow to his mother; if Jupiter does not aspect, he brings ruin to the maternal lineage.

shlokas.text: स्वक्षेत्रे च यदा सूर्यः कन्यायां क्रूरगेहगः। ्रूरक्षेत्रे यदा राहुः षष्टवर्षण जीवति
shlokas.english_draft: If the Sun is in own sign, a planet in Virgo in a malefic house, and Rahu in a malefic sign, the native lives for six years.

shlokas.text: अष्टमस्थे निशानाथे केन्द्रे च क्रूर संस्थितः कर्मस्थाने यदा राहुः वर्षमेकोन विंशतिः
shlokas.english_draft: If Moon is in the 8th house, malefics in Kendras, and Rahu in the 10th house, longevity is nineteen years.

shlokas.text: उच्वस्थानगतः सौम्यः केन्द्रसथाने भवति चेत्‌। घ्रुवं राज्यं भवेत्तस्य कूटुम्बाधारनिस्चयः
shlokas.english_draft: If an exalted benefic planet occupies a Kendra house, rulership/kingdom is certain and he becomes the mainstay of his family.

shlokas.text: सप्तमे भवने भानुः मध्यस्थो भूमिनन्दनः। राहुर्लग्ने यदा जातः पिता तस्य न जीवति
shlokas.english_draft: If Sun is in the 7th house, Mars in mid-sky (10th house), and Rahu in Lagna, the native's father does not survive.

shlokas.text: रमरे व्यये तृतीये चाष्टमे क्रूरग्रहो यदि। तदा जातस्य पुत्रस्य शरीरे कष्टमादिशेत्‌
shlokas.english_draft: If malefic planets are in the 7th (Smara), 12th, 3rd, and 8th houses, bodily affliction is predicted for the born son.

shlokas.text: स्वक्षत्रसथो यदा जीवो बुधसौरियुतस्तदा | दीरघायुर्जायते तस्य संपदश्च पदे पदे
shlokas.english_draft: If Jupiter is in its own sign joined with Mercury and Saturn, the native becomes long-lived and gains prosperity at every step.

shlokas.text: मीने शुक्रो यदा जीवश्चंद्रमा च यदा भवेत्‌| जातस्य राज्य-सौभाग्यं बहुपुत्रकटुम्बवान्‌
shlokas.english_draft: If Venus, Jupiter, and Moon are in Pisces, the native gains royal fortune, many sons, and a large family.

shlokas.text: धने राहर्बुधः शुक्रः सौरिः सूर्योयदा ग्रहः। तदा मातुः भवेन्मृत्युश्चतुर्थं दशमे पिता
shlokas.english_draft: If Rahu, Mercury, Venus, Saturn, and Sun occupy the 2nd house, death of the mother or destruction of the father occurs.

shlokas.text: लग्ने पापा व्यये पापा निधने पापसंरिथिताः। तदा मातुः भवेन्मृत्युश्चतुर्थं दशमे पिता
shlokas.english_draft: If malefics occupy Lagna, 12th, and 8th (Nidhana) houses, death of the mother occurs, or of the father if in 4th and 10th houses.
